Name: EQUIP_PARAM_GOODS_ST
Description: Defines goods: non-equipment items such as consumables and key items, with their use restrictions, effects and menu data.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the NT version or mark the ones to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Release Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the product version or mark the items to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Reference ID: 1
Fields.Description: Default Bullet or SpEffect called by the item, as chosen by Reference Type.

Fields.Name: Particle Variation ID
Fields.Description: Specify SFX variation (used to identify SFX in combination with TimeActEditor ID)

Fields.Name: Weight
Fields.Description: Weight. In kilograms.

Fields.Name: Base Value
Fields.Description: Base price

Fields.Name: Sell Value
Fields.Description: Selling price

Fields.Name: Behavior ID
Fields.Description: Behavior action ID applied when item is used.

Fields.Name: Replacement Item ID
Fields.Description: Item ID this item is replaced with.

Fields.Name: Sort ID
Fields.Description: Menu sort order. -1: not gathered (likely excluded from grouping in the menu).

Fields.Name: QWC ID
Fields.Description: The ID this item uses for world tendency.

Fields.Name: Message Text ID
Fields.Description: Message ID used when displaying the YesNo dialog.

Fields.Name: Max Held Count
Fields.Description: The maximum number of this item held.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Icon ID used for this item.

Fields.Name: Model ID
Fields.Description: Model ID used for this item.

Fields.Name: Shop Level
Fields.Description: Level that can be sold at the store

Fields.Name: Achievement ID
Fields.Description: Sequence number of the completion-type achievement this item counts towards.

Fields.Name: Sequential Achievement ID
Fields.Description: Sequence number of the achievement this item is associated with.

Fields.Name: Legacy: Max Held Count
Fields.Description: The maximum number of this item held.

Fields.Name: Humanity Consumption
Fields.Description: The amount of humanity consumption on use.

Fields.Name: Dexterity over Start Value
Fields.Description: Dexterity value at which the over-dexterity effect starts.

Fields.Name: Goods Type
Fields.Description: The type of item.

Fields.Name: Reference Type
Fields.Description: Category of the Reference IDs: attack, projectile (Bullet) or special (SpEffect).

Fields.Name: Behavior Category
Fields.Description: Category of the actions this item creates, so SpEffects that change parameters (for example boosting only weapon attacks) can target them. Set None for items that need no category.

Fields.Name: Item Category
Fields.Description: Category for this item.

Fields.Name: Item Use Animation
Fields.Description: Set the animation to play when using the item.

Fields.Name: Interaction Menu Type
Fields.Description: Menu type that opens when using an item.

Fields.Name: Use Limit Category
Fields.Description: Limit usage based on applied SpEffect.

Fields.Name: Replace Category
Fields.Description: Condition category whose value is added to the Reference ID.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 0
Fields.Description: If ON, the item can be used while in pledge 0.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 1
Fields.Description: If ON, the item can be used while in pledge 1.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 2
Fields.Description: If ON, the item can be used while in pledge 2.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 3
Fields.Description: If ON, the item can be used while in pledge 3.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 4
Fields.Description: If ON, the item can be used while in pledge 4.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 5
Fields.Description: If ON, the item can be used while in pledge 5.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 6
Fields.Description: If ON, the item can be used while in pledge 6.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 7
Fields.Description: If ON, the item can be used while in pledge 7.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 8
Fields.Description: If ON, the item can be used while in pledge 8.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 9
Fields.Description: If ON, the item can be used while in pledge 9.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 10
Fields.Description: If ON, the item can be used while in pledge 10.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 11
Fields.Description: If ON, the item can be used while in pledge 11.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 12
Fields.Description: If ON, the item can be used while in pledge 12.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 13
Fields.Description: If ON, the item can be used while in pledge 13.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 14
Fields.Description: If ON, the item can be used while in pledge 14.

Fields.Name: Pledge Type: 15
Fields.Description: If ON, the item can be used while in pledge 15.

Fields.Name: Enable as Host Player
Fields.Description: If ON, this item is usable if the user is a host player.

Fields.Name: Enable as Gray Phantom
Fields.Description: If ON, this item is usable if the user is a gray phantom player.

Fields.Name: Enable as White Phantom
Fields.Description: If ON, this item is usable if the user is a white phantom player.

Fields.Name: Enable as Black Phantom
Fields.Description: If ON, this item is usable if the user is a black phantom player.

Fields.Name: Enable in Multiplayer
Fields.Description: If ON, this item is usable in a multiplayer session.

Fields.Name: Disabled Offline
Fields.Description: If ON, this item cannot be used while offline.

Fields.Name: Is Equippable
Fields.Description: If ON, this item can be equipped.

Fields.Name: Is Consumed
Fields.Description: If ON, this item can be consumed. This will remove one instance of the item upon consumption.

Fields.Name: Is Automatically Equipped
Fields.Description: If ON, this item is automatically equipped when picked up.

Fields.Name: Is Placed Item
Fields.Description: If ON, this item places an object in the world.

Fields.Name: Is Unique Item
Fields.Description: If ON, only one of this item can be held.

Fields.Name: Can Discard
Fields.Description: If ON, this item can be discarded.

Fields.Name: Can Deposit
Fields.Description: If ON, this item can be deposited into the repository.

Fields.Name: Disable if Right Hand is Empty
Fields.Description: If ON, this item cannot be used when the right-handed weapon is empty.

Fields.Name: Is Travel Item
Fields.Description: If ON, this item is considered a 'travel' item.

Fields.Name: Is Replenishable Item
Fields.Description: If ON, this item is a replenishable item.

Fields.Name: Is Replenished Item
Fields.Description: If ON, this item is the already-replenished (full) state of a replenishable item.

Fields.Name: Is Weapon Enchant
Fields.Description: If ON, using this item enchants the weapon.

Fields.Name: Is Repair Item
Fields.Description: If ON, this item is used to repair equipment.

Fields.Name: Disable Multiplayer Drop Sharing
Fields.Description: If ON, a dropped copy of this item is not shared with other players in multiplayer.

Fields.Name: Is Disabled in PvP Arena
Fields.Description: If ON, this item cannot be used when in the PvP arena.

Fields.Name: Is Enabled only in PvP Arena
Fields.Description: If ON, this item can only be used in the PvP arena.

Fields.Name: Is Early Cancel Enabled
Fields.Description: If ON, this item's usage can be cancelled early.

Fields.Name: Are SpEffect Modifiers Applied
Fields.Description: If ON, SpEffect modifiers are applied.

Fields.Name: Synchronized Item ID
Fields.Description: When this item's count changes, held items with the same ID change with it. 0: not synchronised.

Fields.Name: Reference ID: 2
Fields.Description: Second Bullet or SpEffect called by the item, as chosen by Reference Type. Used instead of Reference ID: 1 when the item enchants the left weapon held two-handed (see Use Reference ID 2 for Left Two-Handing).

Fields.Name: Weapon ID
Fields.Description: Weapon ID to use to populate weapon parameters for offensive items.

Fields.Name: Vagrant Item Lot ID
Fields.Description: -1: no vagrant. 0: no lottery. 1 or more: lottery ID.

Fields.Name: Vagrant Enemy Item Lot ID
Fields.Description: -1: no drop. 0: no lottery. 1 or more: lottery ID.

Fields.Name: Vagrant Bonus Item Lot ID
Fields.Description: -1: no drop. 0: no lottery. 1 or more: lottery ID.

Fields.Name: Particle ID: Cast
Fields.Description: Particle effect played from when the item starts being used until it takes effect.

Fields.Name: Particle ID: Fire
Fields.Description: Particle effect played when the item takes effect.

Fields.Name: Particle ID: Effect
Fields.Description: Particle effect played while the item's effect is active, after it takes effect.

Fields.Name: Obtain Medal Emblem
Fields.Description: If ON, this item counts towards obtaining a medal emblem.

Fields.Name: Is Bonfire Warp Item
Fields.Description: Marks bonfire warp items. Likely no longer blocks the item under Warp Prohibition: the original notes say that function was removed from this flag (see Is Affected by Warp Prohibition).

Fields.Name: Is Usable on Ladder
Fields.Description: If ON, the item can be used whilst on a ladder.

Fields.Name: Usable before Multiplayer Session
Fields.Description: If ON, the item can be used between session establishment and initial synchronisation in multiplayer.

Fields.Name: Can Use Multiple
Fields.Description: If ON, multiple instances can be used simultaneously.

Fields.Name: Use Reference ID 2 for Left Two-Handing
Fields.Description: If ON and the item enchants a weapon, Reference ID: 2 is used while the left weapon is held two-handed.

Fields.Name: Is Affected by Warp Prohibition
Fields.Description: If ON, then warp prohibition will disable this item.

Fields.Name: Only Usable with Disconnect Penalty
Fields.Description: If ON, the item can only be used while a client disconnect penalty is in effect.

Fields.Name: Replenishment Type
Fields.Description: The type of replenishment to apply when replenishing this item.

Fields.Name: Automatic Replenishment Type
Fields.Description: The type of automatic replenishment available, and whether it is enabled or disabled by default.

Fields.Name: Can be Dropped
Fields.Description: If ON, this item can be dropped.

Fields.Name: Is Local Player Sound Playback Only
Fields.Description: If ON, the use sound effect is only played for the player using the item.

Fields.Name: Max Repository Count
Fields.Description: The maximum number of this item that can be stored in the repository system.

Fields.Name: HUD Icon ID
Fields.Description: The icon ID for the weapon panel HUD.

Fields.Name: Sale Value
Fields.Description: Price the item is on sale for.

Fields.Name: Re-use Time
Fields.Description: The usage cooldown. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Sound ID: On Use
Fields.Description: The sound ID to play when the item is used.
